M003.label: afflicted
M003.quote: Ketu's disposition in Navamsa ... indicating a checkered career, suffering and confinement in chains all of which Savarkar had in plenty.
M003.note: Window ended at chart header; conclusion found further on (also 'Bandhana yogas are well pronounced', line 10609).

M011.label: none
M011.note: Nothing is said about Tantri's mother; the 4th lord in 4th is read only for education (First Class M.A.).

M019.label: afflicted
M019.quote: The 5th house is completely spoiled when viewed from Chandra Lagna ... Goethe had but one son who also died which calamity Goethe could not stand

M027.label: favourable
M027.quote: During Rahu Dasa also, the native went abroad several times representing his country.
M027.note: Sailed for England 1905; Dasas 'gave him much foreign travel' (line 8839).

M035.label: favourable
M035.quote: "imperialism" became the queen's mood and the queen became the symbolic foundation of the new British Empire.
M035.note: Reign of 63 years; empire expanded in Saturn Dasa.

M043.label: afflicted
M043.quote: the Putsch he organised to overthrow the Government was a failure and that he found himself in prison for treason.

M051.label: favourable
M051.quote: Because all the three factors connected with the second house are strong and well-fortified, there are indications of immense wealth.

M059.label: favourable
M059.quote: The Lagna and the lord of Lagna are disposed so strongly in this horoscope that they are capable of lifting the native by his own efforts to a position of considerable honour and celebrity.
M059.note: Remarks: 'risen to eminence as an industrialist by sheer merit' (line 13862).

M067.label: favourable
M067.quote: The total longevity would be 83 years 3 months 22 days + 2 years 10 months 28 days -86 years 2 months 20
M067.note: Only a Pindayu arithmetic illustration; Raman gives no judgment of the native's actual life span beyond the computed figure.

M075.label: favourable
M075.quote: Conclusion : The strong disposition of the Lagna lord, the 8th houses and 3rd house and their respective lords both from Lagna and Moon-sign would place the native in the Poornayu group.
M075.note: Death timed to Rahu Dasa Sun Bhukti, native died 7-2-1966 at about 70, consistent with long life.

M083.label: afflicted
M083.quote: there would be trouble through secret machinations, humiliation, discomfiture and loss of pride, all of which the Nizam had in large measure.
M083.note: 6th afflicted by Jupiter, Mars, Rahu; the Nizam suffered opposition and loss of power; quote tied partly to Jupiter in 12th.

M091.label: favourable
M091.quote: The subject will therefore contract no debts whatsoever. The financial position will generally be sound.

M099.label: afflicted
M099.quote: native spends extravagantly on drink and has an extra-marital life as well.

M107.label: mixed
M107.quote: The Sun, the Moon and Lagna representing the tripod of life are in common, movable and fixed signs respectively indicating middle life or Madhyayu.
M107.note: Raman's only longevity verdict is Madhyayu (middle life); died 1925 aged about 60 in Jupiter Dasa Saturn Bhukti.

M123.label: none
M123.note: Chart 258 is discussed only for the 12th house/moksha (exalted sage); nothing about gains (11th).

M131.label: favourable
M131.quote: Lagna lord the Moon occupying the tenth a martian sign, and otherwise unafflicted, confers a sturdy physical frame, an active and dynamic personality

M139.label: favourable
M139.quote: Throughout his long and memorable reign of 40 years. His Highness showed a rare conscientiousness and disinterested zeal for the promotion of the welfare of his subjects

M147.label: afflicted
M147.quote: The house of children is not well situated ... Her life was made more unhappy by the constant harping on her barren condition which went on all around her for years.

M155.label: afflicted
M155.quote: Though six planets are concentrated in the 10th, the native is not an entity and is at present in humble circumstances.
M155.note: 'All the three factors pertaining to the 1st house are rather unfortunately disposed.'

M163.label: afflicted
M163.quote: The native married in Ketu Bhukti of Rahu Dasa and was widowed in the same Bhukti, exactly a year later.
M163.note: Raman concedes the strong 7th lord 'gave a good husband and did not deny marriage', but the verdict is widowhood (Vaidhavya Yoga).

M171.label: favourable
M171.quote: With all his hideous defects of character, this combination enables us to admire Aurangzeb's courage, energy and ability, with which to the very last, he conducted the affairs of his Government in person.
M171.note: Reign of 44 years as emperor; Raman also notes 10th 'not clean' giving hypocrisy and a second phase of fruitless Deccan wars.

M179.label: afflicted
M179.quote: Ketu in the 6th or house of enemies aspected by Lagna lord Saturn, and the lord of the 6th fairly strong and associated with Saturn, gave him a formidable number of enemies
M179.note: Also 'innumerable enemies even amongst his own kith and kin'.

M187.label: afflicted
M187.quote: Hyder was not happy with regard to his children and the period of prosperity that attended his son Tippu, after Hyder's death, was brief.
M187.note: Window was for Goethe/Hyder remarks; conclusion found at line 5292.

M195.label: afflicted
M195.quote: Lagna lord weak, Ayushkaraka afflicted and the 8th lord in a malefic sign conferred Madhyayu. The peculiar Rajayoga ... deprived him of his head and empire.
M195.note: Killed on the battlefield at Srirangapatna; 'No wonder that Tippu lost his life and empire.'

M203.label: afflicted
M203.quote: The father of the native died in March 1962 In Saturn Bhukti of Rahu Dasa.
M203.note: Native born 1951, so father died when native was about 10; pitrukaraka debilitated, 9th lord from Moon heavily afflicted.

M211.label: afflicted
M211.quote: all the malefic Influences have been centered on the house of fortune with the result he was deprived of the fortune of ruling an empire.

M219.label: favourable
M219.quote: Chart No. 35 is the horoscope of a fortunate but self- made man.

M227.label: favourable
M227.quote: These two sets of combinations have fortified 'wealth' considerably.
M227.note: Also 'influx of considerable wealth'; newspaper magnate.

M235.label: favourable
M235.quote: The house of education and intellectual acquisitions is pretty strong. ... the native possesses amazing intellectual versatility

M243.label: favourable
M243.quote: Arishta yogas for suffering evenly balanced with Rajayogas and Lagna and Lagna lord fully fortified reveal Tilak's stainless purity of life, immense sacrifice
M243.note: Self/Lagna fortified, 'sound, healthy constitution of great vitality' (line 7176); the suffering (imprisonment, diabetes) is attributed to Bandhana yogas, not to a weak Lagna.

M251.label: favourable
M251.quote: The native's father is a big business magnate ana still actively alive at 75 years.

M259.label: favourable
M259.quote: Jupiter exalted and aspecting the 12th from Pada Lagna and the lord of the 4th from Karakamsa being aspected by Venus are factors indicating wealth and riches.
M259.note: Only a short factor-based statement; no explicit narrative about Truman's finances.

M267.label: favourable
M267.quote: Jupiter in the 2nd house made Bose a clear, forceful and convincing speaker.

M275.label: favourable
M275.quote: Lagna lord aspecting the 8th and Saturn Ayushkaraka in a benefic sign denote good longevity.

M283.label: favourable
M283.quote: This denotes that the subject was very much attached to her husband and dominated by his influence. He became the queen's partner in politics
M283.note: Husband's later death caused prolonged grief, but Raman's marital verdict is attachment and partnership; nine children.

M291.label: favourable
M291.quote: The native acquired an immense fortune in Jupiter's Dasa, Sun's Bhukti in the form of immovable properties, book-royalties and otner assets

M299.label: mixed
M299.quote: The affliction of the 4th house by the presence of Mars and Ketu denotes that his education was of a desultory character, but the presence of Saraswathi Yoga enabled him to acquire distinction later on in iife.

M307.label: favourable
M307.quote: Dhanakaraka Jupiter in Lagna with Mercury and Rajyakaraka Sun — and all placed in a kendra from the other Rajyakaraka Moon should be sufficient to confer wealth.
M307.note: Raman says to a superficial observer the Dhanabhava looks weak, then concludes wealth is conferred.

M315.label: afflicted
M315.quote: the house as well as the lord of brothers come under severe affliction. There by the indications of the house suffer. The subject of the chart has no brothers.
